practices.pm_mission: Limit host exposure to bacterial endotoxin and related inflammatory microbial products.
practices.input: Tested fibre/fruit-rich mixed meal versus the high-fat/high-carbohydrate comparison
practices.biological_role: The meal comparison measured different acute plasma endotoxin/LBP responses.
practices.limitation: Small parallel-group acute comparison; multiple ingredients and macronutrients differed. No isolated fibre, fruit or constituent effect; LAL/LBP are not direct proof of gut leakage, portal origin, LPS bioactivity or brain benefit. CRP and TNF-alpha did not change.
practices.exposure_qualification: Small parallel-group acute comparison; multiple ingredients and macronutrients differed. No isolated fibre, fruit or constituent effect; LAL/LBP are not direct proof of gut leakage, portal origin, LPS bioactivity or brain benefit. CRP and TNF-alpha did not change.

mechanistic_evidence.label: Ghanim et al. (2009)
mechanistic_evidence.exposure_context: 910-kcal mixed meals: oatmeal/milk/orange juice/raisins/peanut butter/English muffin versus egg/sausage muffins and hash browns.
mechanistic_evidence.directional_finding: NF-kB DNA-binding activity rose after the tested high-fat/high-carbohydrate meal but not after the isocaloric fibre/fruit-rich comparison.

assessment.study: 910-kcal mixed meals: oatmeal/milk/orange juice/raisins/peanut butter/English muffin versus egg/sausage muffins and hash browns.
assessment.population: Two parallel groups of ten healthy lean adults.
assessment.result: NF-kB DNA-binding activity rose after the tested high-fat/high-carbohydrate meal but not after the isocaloric fibre/fruit-rich comparison.
assessment.effect_magnitude: Only the specified source-level endpoint is assessed; no pooled effect or food-dose estimate is inferred.
assessment.evidence_summary: Mononuclear-cell NF-kB DNA binding by electrophoretic mobility shift assay; plasma LPS by LAL and LBP.
assessment.limitations: Small parallel-group acute comparison; multiple ingredients and macronutrients differed. No isolated fibre, fruit or constituent effect; LAL/LBP are not direct proof of gut leakage, portal origin, LPS bioactivity or brain benefit. CRP and TNF-alpha did not change.
assessment.retrieval_scope: Primary full text Methods and Results, including assay methods and Table 1, retrieved. Random allocation was not established.
